# Keep LLM reasoning out of latency-critical paths when deterministic execution suffices

## What

# Convert rare failure rates into expected exposure and downstream error cost

## What

Convert rare failure rates into expected exposure and downstream error cost

A tiny per-interaction risk becomes frequent at large volume; quantify exposure and severity rather than accepting a good-looking average score.

## Evidence

> you have a one in a million uh sort of occurrence uh it will happen 200 times
> — 02:27 [^OrtBEBLMXdM]

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Stop spending on non-informative checks or comparisons
- **Speed:** Faster diagnosis using existing evidence
- **Quality:** Outcome-valid rather than proxy-only judgments
- **Reliability:** Detect uncertainty, bias, drift and invalid scoring
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

# Generate candidate tasks backwards from verifiable artifacts and validate their labels

## What

Generate candidate tasks backwards from verifiable artifacts and validate their labels

Instead of labeling real data, they sample a label and a reasoning trace first, then generate the input data conditioned on it, so labels are correct by construction and rare edge cases can be synthesized on demand.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Stop spending on non-informative checks or comparisons
- **Speed:** Faster diagnosis using existing evidence
- **Quality:** Outcome-valid rather than proxy-only judgments
- **Reliability:** Detect uncertainty, bias, drift and invalid scoring
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

# Treat persona prompting as a style hypothesis, not evidence of improved factual accuracy

## What

Treat persona prompting as a style hypothesis, not evidence of improved factual accuracy

Ran a case study giving models 'genius math professor' vs 'idiot who can't do math' roles on GSM8K; the dumb role scored higher, showing role prompts don't improve accuracy.

## Evidence

Source analysis [^_BRhRh7mOX0]; no independently matched timestamped quote published.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Stop spending on non-informative checks or comparisons
- **Speed:** Faster diagnosis using existing evidence
- **Quality:** Outcome-valid rather than proxy-only judgments
- **Reliability:** Detect uncertainty, bias, drift and invalid scoring
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

# Measure healthy delivered outcomes and recent-code rework, not activity

## What

Measure healthy delivered outcomes and recent-code rework, not activity

Track post-merge reliability, security, maintainability and rework alongside throughput so a temporary increase in generated code does not hide a growing debt workload.

# Distinguish adaptation failures from unstable behavior before changing memory or prompts

## What

Distinguish adaptation failures from unstable behavior before changing memory or prompts

Classifies continual-learning failure modes into stability failures (not retaining prior information, e.g. reverting to an earlier wrong prediction) and plasticity failures (not updating priors from new evidence, e.g. dismissing a schema as irrelevant when it applies).

# Inspect a tiny costed canary before scaling any authorized bulk inference job

## What

Inspect a tiny costed canary before scaling any authorized bulk inference job

Looking at the first generated candidates and their errors reveals a broken objective or refiner before repeated calls amplify wasted spend.

## Evidence

> it. Basically what I did is I stopped at the first iteration, found some example
> — 36:24 [^X4dEHRzBLmc]

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Stop spending on non-informative checks or comparisons
- **Speed:** Faster diagnosis using existing evidence
- **Quality:** Outcome-valid rather than proxy-only judgments
- **Reliability:** Detect uncertainty, bias, drift and invalid scoring
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Less repeated investigation
- **Speed:** Faster reuse of relevant prior work
- **Quality:** More current, scoped lessons
- **Reliability:** Less stale, conflicting or unsupported recall
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

## What

Distill task-specific behavior only from validated traces with a maintenance case

# Use supported telemetry hooks and test adapter coverage rather than relying blindly on monkey patches

## What

Use supported telemetry hooks and test adapter coverage rather than relying blindly on monkey patches

Instrumentations monkey-patch the client library (LLM SDK, vector DB client) so spans/metrics are emitted automatically with negligible latency, instead of hand-adding logging in agent code.

## Evidence

Source analysis [^KVgbERRPU4M]; no independently matched timestamped quote published.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Target verified waste rather than speculative fixes
- **Speed:** Shorter evidence-based incident diagnosis
- **Quality:** Explain actual behavior and outcomes
- **Reliability:** Detect silent failures and attribute changes
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

# Bound replay work with checkpoints while retaining the authoritative raw event history

## What

Bound replay work with checkpoints while retaining the authoritative raw event history

Notes that wrapping every LLM/tool call as a replay step makes the journal grow until it hits entry-count or entry-size limits, and replay journal versioning breaks on redeploy.

## Evidence

Source analysis [^svCnShDvgQg]; no independently matched timestamped quote published.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Fewer full restarts and no-progress loops
- **Speed:** Less polling, contention and recovery delay
- **Quality:** Checkable intermediate and final outcomes
- **Reliability:** Bounded recoverable state transitions
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

# Persist wait conditions and resume on signals instead of holding a polling agent open

## What

Persist wait conditions and resume on signals instead of holding a polling agent open

A durable timer can suspend a workflow until a future event without occupying an agent process or repeatedly re-entering an LLM loop.

## Evidence

Source analysis [^ZB7l4uxW3Yo]; no independently matched timestamped quote published.

> while we are waiting this process actually suspends. So if it's running on
> — 08:56 [^cI7zfqusmFU]

> days in here. Temporal would take care of pausing everything. Again, I'm not
> — 18:12 [^flf_IKnFYnE]

Source analysis [^jc3kbZkuHTo]; no independently matched timestamped quote published.

> when the user comes back and gives you that input, it just reconstitutes memory
> — 59:32 [^k8cnVCMYmNc]

Source analysis [^vi-2nasppAg]; no independently matched timestamped quote published.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Fewer full restarts and no-progress loops
- **Speed:** Less polling, contention and recovery delay
- **Quality:** Checkable intermediate and final outcomes
- **Reliability:** Bounded recoverable state transitions
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

Declare safe degraded modes when understanding or dependency fidelity is insufficient

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Fewer full restarts and no-progress loops
- **Speed:** Less polling, contention and recovery delay
- **Quality:** Checkable intermediate and final outcomes
- **Reliability:** Bounded recoverable state transitions
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

# Represent workflow state transitions and terminal outcomes explicitly

## What

Represent workflow state transitions and terminal outcomes explicitly

State/event/guard definitions make valid lifecycle moves explicit and reject invalid transitions before side effects occur.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Fewer full restarts and no-progress loops
- **Speed:** Less polling, contention and recovery delay
- **Quality:** Checkable intermediate and final outcomes
- **Reliability:** Bounded recoverable state transitions
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

## What

## Evidence

Source analysis [^aeTb5BdmTTc]; no independently matched timestamped quote published.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Fewer duplicate or misdirected runs
- **Speed:** Less blocked work and handoff delay
- **Quality:** More verifiable customer-relevant scope

# Resolve conflicting specialist findings against evidence, not majority vote

Resolve conflicting specialist findings against evidence, not majority vote

# Reuse reviews on unchanged input and review only the delta on new heads

## What

Reuse reviews on unchanged input and review only the delta on new heads

Snyk ran the newest models five times on the same vulnerability and found that detection is not repeatable. Their conclusion is that an LLM validator must sit behind deterministic checks and must not be trusted as a single coin flip.

## Evidence

# Use a deterministic, evidence-gated fast lane for genuinely low-risk changes

## What

Use a deterministic, evidence-gated fast lane for genuinely low-risk changes

Simple policies decide which changes need a deep review. Routine docs, non-breaking dependency bumps and security patches can be auto-approved. Sensitive paths (payments, auth) escalate. The authoring agent never approves its own change.

# Convert repeatable conventions into lint, tests and governed rule assets

## What

Convert repeatable conventions into lint, tests and governed rule assets

Agents have no memory and repeat the same elementary mistakes, and compaction erases corrections. Writing a linter is now cheap because the agent writes it. So, on a schedule, mine past transcripts and review comments for repeated feedback and codify the deterministic ones as lint rules, e.g. design-system component use, OpenAPI decorators, or skill code blocks that must type-check. Expect whack-a-mole: the agent first dodged the rule by deleting the code blocks, then the backticks.

# Compute security exposure from actual service, data and network relationships

## What

Compute security exposure from actual service, data and network relationships

Join service versions, listener configuration, firewall/routing exposure and ownership to identify reachable obsolete services and management ports; these are multi-hop inventory questions rather than prose similarity questions.

## Evidence

Source analysis [^Q0VkgCyNVUg]; no independently matched timestamped quote published.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Avoid incident recovery and unauthorized side-effect cost
- **Speed:** Reduce unsafe improvisation and repeated denials
- **Quality:** Preserve authorized task correctness
- **Reliability:** Contain credential, data and execution blast radius
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

# Bind sensitive side effects to exact validated payload and current state

## What

Bind sensitive side effects to exact validated payload and current state

Deterministic code owns control flow, evidence and side effects. Each external action has its own gate, and its approval is tied to the hash of the exact payload and re-checked right before execution. Side effects move through prepared → sent → completed. An unknown outcome goes to manual review, never to an automatic retry. Follow-ups run as new child plans (at most 5 rounds); the approved parent never changes. Wait expiry (default 72 h) is decided by a rule, not a model.

# Verify data parity with row-count, key and column-level checks before promoting a transform

# Require new regression tests to fail on the unfixed base revision

## What

Require new regression tests to fail on the unfixed base revision

Benchmarks such as SWE-bench check out the base commit, revert the agent's test edits and apply hidden tests. Frontier Code goes further and penalizes any model-written test that passes on the pre-patch code, because such a test does not exercise the change. The idea transfers as a deterministic check: run the PR's new or changed tests against base code. A test that passes there is vacuous for a fix or feature.

## Evidence

Source analysis [^Ib5GBkD555M]; no independently matched timestamped quote published.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Catch failures before expensive review and reruns
- **Speed:** Faster scoped feedback and shorter CI critical paths
- **Quality:** Stronger behavioral and negative-case coverage
- **Reliability:** Repeatable regression and recovery evidence
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Catch failures before expensive review and reruns
- **Speed:** Faster scoped feedback and shorter CI critical paths
- **Quality:** Stronger behavioral and negative-case coverage
- **Reliability:** Repeatable regression and recovery evidence
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

# Detect tautological, source-reading and over-mocked tests that can make green CI misleading

## What

Detect tautological, source-reading and over-mocked tests that can make green CI misleading

Three named patterns of tests that lie: tests that restate a constant or the implementation; tests that read source text to check UI ordering; mocks that remove real failure modes, so the test cannot fail. Countermeasures: deep modules with small interfaces that tests go through, a red test first (TDD), and a reviewer that checks what the tests actually assert.

# Collapse fixed multi-call sequences into task-shaped deterministic tools

## What

Collapse fixed multi-call sequences into task-shaped deterministic tools

Per-step success compounds (99% per step over 100 steps is about 36% end to end), and cost accrues on every step. So every step that needs no judgment moves into a deterministic function or tool: authentication, download plus fetch, verification against the system of record. An SOP skill pins the critical path for whatever remains.

# Represent unknown, missing and partial state distinctly from zero, false or success

## What

Represent unknown, missing and partial state distinctly from zero, false or success

Include an unknown-text or unhandled-intent branch in the schema, allowing correct partial extraction while preserving the parts the model could not map instead of forcing every phrase into a supported action.

## Evidence

> that we ingest and load the data. And if you make that modular, then you can

> reason that it did is because we have this thing called unknown text so we've
> — 09:16 [^UNKDAo8YNmg]

> are currently no hotel listed in Antarctica. Of course, because it create
> — 27:36 [^vJukHCIv7Ck]

> results actually a valid response or is it a
> — 27:58 [^ynJyIKwjonM]

## How to apply (generic)

Test the smallest supported intervention on representative tasks. Compare against a baseline, check correctness and failure cases, and retain a rollback before wider use.

## Expected effect

- **Cost:** Fewer model-owned steps and malformed calls
- **Speed:** Shorter reliable tool chains
- **Quality:** Clearer contracts and evidence
- **Reliability:** Fail-loud errors and recoverable execution
- **Certainty:** Expected directions, not measured local gains; savings across clusters overlap and must not be added.

# Assess dependency and vendor change-handling evidence before relying on an integration

## What

Assess dependency and vendor change-handling evidence before relying on an integration

When picking platforms, they look at how the vendor handled the last 6-12 months of transitions, not just current features and roadmap.
